index_description: How the store runs, who works on it, and what connects to it.
index_empty_title: Your role has no settings to open
index_empty_description: Ask the store owner if you need access. Your own account is always under Your account.
store_name_description: Shown to staff here and to shoppers in the storefront. Up to 100 characters.
store_email_description: Where shoppers and agents can write to you. Storefronts show it.
store_description_description: Plain text, for your storefront's header or search results.
store_language_description: Translations come later; the language says what your content is written in now.
store_content_language_description: A BCP 47 tag: en, en-GB, sr-Latn…
store_time_zone_description: Times are stored in UTC; this is how your store's clients show them.
store_costs_description: What you pay suppliers is converted to one currency, so stock value and margins add up across markets.
store_base_currency_description: Purchase orders, unit costs and stock value are kept in it. It can't change once a cost is recorded.
store_legal_description: For invoices and legal pages. Leave every address field blank to have none.
setup_guide_description: Finished or hidden. Show it again in the menu and on the home page, from the step it was left on.
channels_description: Where your products are sold: your online store, AI agents, or anywhere else. A product is sold in the channels it's published to, from its page.
channels_card_description: A storefront sells through the channel its publishable key belongs to.
channel_kind_custom_description: Anywhere else: a marketplace, a kiosk.
channel_dialog_subtitle: It sells nothing until you publish products to it.
channel_name_description: Shown to staff. Unique, ignoring case.
channel_kind_description: What the channel is for. Can't change later.
channel_key_subtitle: A publishable key: storefronts read and sell what this channel publishes with it.
channel_key_subtitle_created: Copy it now: it isn't shown again. It's publishable, so it can sit in a storefront's code.
search_description: The filters and listings shoppers get on your storefront's search and category pages.
search_index_waiting: {count, plural, one {# product is} other {# products are}} waiting to be rebuilt. Search keeps answering meanwhile, with the old data for those.
search_index_current: Every product change has reached search. Edits to products, prices and stock show within a few seconds.
search_index_hint: The index holds one entry per variant in each market that sells it. Rebuild it only after restoring a database, or if search shows something it shouldn't.
search_intro_description: Your storefront's search, category pages and product listings all come from the search index. Here you choose:
search_intro_filters: Filters — the checklists shoppers narrow results with (Color, Size, Brand…). Price and availability are always offered.
search_intro_listings: Listings — whether a product with several colours shows once, or once per colour.
search_scanned_all: The choices below come from your {count, plural, one {# product} other {# products}}.
search_scanned_newest: The choices below come from your {count, plural, one {# newest product} other {# newest products}} (options and tags from the 60 newest); counts are among those.
search_filters_description: Changes show on the storefront as soon as you save; nothing is rebuilt.
search_filters_custom_on: Shoppers see these filters, in this order.
search_filters_custom_off: Shoppers see product type, vendor, every option your products have (most used first) and tags.
search_filters_empty: No filters yet: add one below.
search_filter_add_hint: The number is how many of the scanned products have it. Leave a label blank to use the name shown.
search_sample_none: No values found on recent products
search_listings_description: Pick an option to show each of its values as its own result, with its own photo and price — like showing a T-shirt once per colour, each with its sizes. Up to {max}. Leave all unticked for one result per product.
search_listings_no_options: None of your products have options yet, so each product is one result.
search_listings_limit: Up to {max} options can split listings.
search_listings_rebuild_hint: Saving this rebuilds the whole search index in the background: results keep working, and the new listings appear as it catches up (see Search index).
search_split_example_one: One result per {option} a product comes in.
search_split_example_two: A product in {first} and {second} shows as 2 results, one per {option}.
search_preview_description: The filter panel shoppers see, with values from your products.
search_preview_results: Results: one per {options} value of each product.
